# Why Waymo Is Paying People to Take Public Transport

**From:** The AV Market Strategist <avmarketstrategist@substack.com>  
**Date:** 2026-11-11T09:53:07.000Z

---

View this post on the web at https://avmarketstrategist.substack.com/p/why-waymo-is-paying-people-to-take

Waymo now pays riders to combine a robotaxi with the bus or train. Is that real integration with public transit, or a smart way to win over transit riders?
Dr. Henriette Cornet has worked on both sides of this question. She led automated mobility at UITP, the global public transport association, coordinated SHOW, the EU-funded project that put automated vehicles on the road in cities across Europe, and designed autonomous public transport in Singapore. Today she runs Urban Innovate in San Francisco, advises cities and transit agencies and teaches at the University of San Francisco.
First, the mechanics. Henriette explains how Waymo’s transit rewards program works with Visa, what changed since the earlier station credit pilot, who the Waymo Cash reward really helps, and why physical access to stations, like Waymo’s staging spaces at Caltrain, may matter more than the $2.85.
Then the big question: are robotaxis and public transit partners or rivals? Henriette explains why road capacity, not price, sets the limit, what data would prove that robotaxis feed transit rather than replace it, and what her research on rider sentiment found about privacy, safety and having other people around.
Finally, the decisions. Which partnership model a transit agency should start with, what to ask for in return, how cities should handle curb space and station parking, what Europe’s SHOW pilots got right, how trust differs between Singapore, the US and Europe, and what a healthy mobility mix in San Francisco could look like in ten years.
